doc: Grass tufts generated near the camera (src/render/city3d/grass.ts). rules (first match wins, the last is a catch-all): cover = land-cover / land-use classes of the vector map (grass, farmland, park, agriculture, scrub, cemetery; a green lawn the map does not list is treated as 'grass'), minAbsLat/maxAbsLat/minElev/maxElev limit by climate. density = tufts per m2 at full density; height = blade height range (m); radius = tuft radius (m); blades = blades per tuft (one triangle each); colors = base sRGB colours (tips are lighter by `tip`). profiles = per graphics profile: radius (m) around the camera where tufts exist (0 = off) and the tuft budget. wind: amp = sway at the blade tip (m), speed = rad/s, scale = spatial frequency of the gusts. fadeFrom = share of the radius where the density starts to fall off.
